title: UnionFS Crashing
body:
Running the latest beta, Ubuntu x64, Amazon Cloud Storage.

rclone mount acde: /home/_/aws_test --allow-other --no-modtime --dir-cache-time=2m &
unionfs-fuse -o allow_other,cow /home/_/local_test=RW:/home/_/aws_test=RO /home/_/crash

Works fine not in a UnionFS but when in a UnionFS:
